cues.text: 第1章。项目总览与使用方式。意义智能被定义为对其他智能活动的方向性调控。本项目把 V7.0 正典、研究系统、工程操作化与发布资产分开管理，避免把一个可运行原型误读为已经证实的理论。
阅读时先看版本与来源，再看证据状态，最后看工程行为。正典 V7.0 是理论来源；研究系统 v0.2.0 是当前公开实现；六层操作栈 v2.0 是 E0 工程扩展；白皮书 v1.1 是应用层摘要。四者不能互换版本号。
本指南的每个章节都可以独立阅读，也按“概念 → 证据 → 工程 → 运行 → 发布 → 验收”的顺序衔接。章节播放器提供独立的中英文合成旁白，字幕与文稿按音频片段生成，不借用旧有声读物的时间轴。
离线使用时请保留整个 project-guide 目录。HTML、脚本、图片、音频、字幕和下载文件都使用相对路径；不需要 CDN、字体服务、API 密钥或网络连接。
先确认对象：正典、研究系统、工程栈还是发布资产。
先确认状态：已核验、工程草案、机制待核验还是人工待定。
需要可运行行为时，直接阅读智能体与只读 MCP 章节。
需要交付时，使用下载中心、构建脚本与验收报告。
动手一步：用顶部语言按钮切换一次，确认正文、图注、导航、下载标签、音频和字幕一起变化，然后播放任意章节。

Chapter 1. Project overview and how to use this guide. Meaning Intelligence is defined as the directional regulation of other intelligent activities. The project keeps the V7.0 canon, research system, engineering operationalization, and publication assets separate so that a runnable prototype is not mistaken for a confirmed theory.

Read in this order: version and provenance, evidence status, then engineering behavior. Canon V7.0 is the theoretical source; research system v0.2.0 is the current public implementation; operational stack v2.0 is an E0 engineering extension; white paper v1.1 is an application-layer summary. Their version numbers are not interchangeable.

Each chapter stands alone, while the sequence moves from concept to evidence, engineering, execution, publishing, and acceptance. The player uses dedicated Chinese and English synthetic narration. Captions and transcripts are generated from the actual audio segments rather than borrowed from an older audiobook timeline.

Keep the complete project-guide directory when using it offline. HTML, scripts, figures, audio, captions, and downloads use relative paths. No CDN, font service, API key, or network connection is required.
Identify the object: canon, research system, engineering stack, or publication asset.
Identify the status: verified, engineering draft, mechanism pending, or human decision pending.
For runnable behavior, go directly to the agent and read-only MCP chapters.
For delivery, use the download center, build script, and verification report.
Try one step: Use the top language control once and confirm that body text, figure captions, navigation, download labels, audio, and subtitles change together; then play any chapter.
第2章。V7.0 正典、版本与来源审计。正典 V7.0 的名称是《意义智能：意义文明的认知操作系统》。权威顺序为 KDP 定稿02中文 V7、英文校对母本、白皮书、MSI 配置、README 与 CHANGELOG。版本号只认 VERSION.yaml。

2026-11-26 的来源审计确认，KDP 定稿02与 V5 副本的 SHA-256 相同，都是 0fedff1ee5775bbc6812cea24f6024e36e54d43fac4776ba6f94c402ff4cb574；它们不是两个独立版本。英文母本 Meaning IntelligenceV7.docx 的记录哈希为 b4225b6371d0ea013fe2ae4db9ac396537e2bf30f94cbda5a2c342e5f570396b。
审计同时记录了上游未修问题：H5 表格单元格截断、H6 简表与卡片冲突、正典英文正文不完整、候选 DOCX 缺少内嵌图片并存在占位。项目没有静默修改正典，而是把冲突保留在审计记录中。
研究系统 v0.2.0 的 0.x 表示研究形成期。只有完成构念验证、首次预测性研究和独立复现后，才进入 1.0。操作栈 v2.0 与 MSI v2.1 各自演进，不能覆盖正典版本。
主正典：KDP 定稿02中文 V7。
英文母本：Meaning IntelligenceV7.docx。
同哈希 V5 副本：只作归档，不并行维护。
引用理论时使用正典章节、H 编号或 claim ID。
动手一步：在撰写任何说明前，先写下对象、版本、来源文件和证据状态；若来源冲突，停止并引用 canon-audit.md。
待核验事项：上游 H5/H6 冲突、英文正文完整性、图片与附录占位仍待正典母工程修订；本指南只报告记录，不声称已修复。

Chapter 2. V7.0 canon, versions, and provenance audit. Canon V7.0 is Meaning Intelligence: The Cognitive Operating System of Meaning Civilization. Authority runs from the KDP Final 02 Chinese V7 text to the English proof mother, white paper, MSI configuration, and finally README/CHANGELOG. VERSION.yaml is the only version source.

The 2026-11-26 provenance audit records the same SHA-256 for KDP Final 02 and the V5 archive copy: 0fedff1ee5775bbc6812cea24f6024e36e54d43fac4776ba6f94c402ff4cb574. They are not independent versions. The English proof mother, Meaning IntelligenceV7.docx, has recorded hash b4225b6371d0ea013fe2ae4db9ac396537e2bf30f94cbda5a2c342e5f570396b.

The audit also records unresolved upstream issues: a truncated H5 table cell, an H6 summary/card conflict, incomplete English body text, and candidate DOCX files without embedded images and with placeholders. The project did not silently edit the canon; it retained these conflicts in the audit.

Research system v0.2.0 uses 0.x to signal research formation. Version 1.0 requires construct validation, a first predictive study, and independent replication. Operational stack v2.0 and MSI v2.1 evolve separately and never replace the canon version.
Primary canon: KDP Final 02 Chinese V7.
English proof mother: Meaning IntelligenceV7.docx.
Same-hash V5 copy: archive only; do not maintain in parallel.
Cite canon sections, H identifiers, or claim IDs for theoretical statements.
Try one step: Before writing any claim, record its object, version, source file, and evidence status. If sources conflict, stop and cite canon-audit.md.
Pending verification: Upstream H5/H6 conflicts, English-body completeness, and image/appendix placeholders remain pending in the canon master project. This guide reports them without claiming repair.
第3章。E0–E6：证据等级不是质量评分。E0–E6 描述一个主张目前被检验到什么程度，而不是它有多好、多有用或多值得相信。V7.0 的 E3 是预注册假设加数据收集，E5 同时包括证伪与存活两个出口。
E0 表示构念已定义，E1 表示已建立数学模型，E2 表示存在测量工具且信效度验证中，E3 表示预注册假设已进入数据收集，E4 表示独立实验室复现，E5 表示预注册证伪标准已受检验，E6 表示跨情境、跨文化、跨时间泛化。
旧项目文档曾把 E3 写成“在新数据上预测正确”、把 E6 写成“框架外领域独立确认”。这两条不是 V7.0 定义，已经废止。升级证据等级必须补上项目内可复核的证据链，不能靠改写措辞完成。
机制成熟度不能自动转移给工程操作化。例如认知负荷文献成熟，不等于 L1 组合已在本项目任务中达到 E4。六层栈本身仍是 E0；把它写成代码、画成动画或接入智能体都不会提高它的等级。
E3 不是“预测已成功”。
E5 不是“很可靠”；被证伪也是有效成果。
证据等级与 claim status 是两套字段。
工程证伪草案须预注册后才能正式处置。
动手一步：为一条结论同时写出 evidence level、claim status、来源与失败条件；缺少任何一项时标记待核验。

Chapter 3. E0–E6: evidence status is not a quality score. E0–E6 describes how far a claim has been tested, not how good, useful, or believable it is. In V7.0, E3 means a preregistered hypothesis with data collection under way, and E5 has two exits: falsified or survived.

E0 means the construct is defined; E1 a mathematical model exists; E2 an instrument exists with reliability and validity under validation; E3 a preregistered hypothesis is in data collection; E4 independent-laboratory replication; E5 the preregistered falsification criterion has been tested; E6 generalization across contexts, cultures, and time.

Earlier project documents described E3 as correct prediction on new data and E6 as confirmation outside the framework. Those were not V7.0 definitions and are retired. Raising a level requires a reviewable project evidence chain, not a wording change.

Mechanism maturity does not transfer automatically to an engineering operationalization. Mature cognitive-load literature does not make the project's L1 package E4. The stack itself remains E0; code, animation, and agent integration do not raise it.
E3 does not mean prediction has succeeded.
E5 does not mean highly reliable; falsification is also a valid result.
Evidence level and claim status are separate fields.
Engineering falsification drafts require preregistration before formal disposition.
Try one step: For one conclusion, write its evidence level, claim status, source, and failure condition. Mark it pending if any field is missing.
第4章。连续意义光谱与判断维度。V7.0 第 8 章用连续光谱带取代固定的三层次。意义可以在抽象度与时间跨度上连续移动；方向、价值、边界是意义判断的三个分析维度，而不是三个固定层级。
早期离散模型的“元意义层”位于光谱抽象端，“情境意义层”位于具体端，中间没有断层。光谱模型目前仍是 MI-C004 的 E0 草案，需要用纵向数据检验连续分布，而不是先验地宣布它成立。
方向回答“朝哪里去”，价值回答“为何值得、对谁值得”，边界回答“范围、限制与停止条件”。MI-C003 提出这三个维度可用因子或结构方法检验；若单一维度解释超过 90% 方差，正典 H2 的失败条件触发。
不要混淆方向—价值—边界与系缚强度分析中的 C/V/E/A 四维度。前者是 §3.2 的意义判断维度，后者属于另一组构造。智能体只把光谱位置作为启发式标签，不把它当作心理测量结果。
连续光谱：抽象 ↔ 具体，长时距 ↔ 短时距。
判断维度：方向、价值、边界。
另一组四维：C/V/E/A，用于系缚强度分析。
光谱位置不是分数，也不是实证等级。
动手一步：选择一个真实决策，分别写出方向、价值、边界，再指出它在光谱中的位置及理由；不要用“高/中/低”替代证据。

Chapter 4. The continuous meaning spectrum and judgment dimensions. V7.0 Chapter 8 replaces fixed levels with a continuous spectrum band. Meaning can move continuously along abstraction and time horizon. Direction, value, and boundary are analytical dimensions of a meaning judgment, not three fixed levels.

In the earlier discrete model, the meta-meaning level sat at the abstract end and contextual meaning at the concrete end, with no gap. The spectrum model remains an E0 draft under MI-C004 and needs longitudinal tests of continuity rather than an a priori declaration.

Direction asks where to go; value asks why it is worthwhile and for whom; boundary asks about scope, limits, and stopping conditions. MI-C003 proposes factor or structural tests of these dimensions. If one dimension explains more than 90% of variance, the canon H2 failure condition is triggered.

Do not confuse direction–value–boundary with the C/V/E/A four-dimensional bonding-strength analysis. The former belongs to §3.2 meaning judgment; the latter is a different construct. The agent treats spectrum position only as a heuristic label, not a psychometric measurement.
Continuous spectrum: abstract ↔ concrete, long horizon ↔ short horizon.
Judgment dimensions: direction, value, boundary.
A separate four-dimensional model: C/V/E/A for bonding strength.
Spectrum position is neither a score nor an evidence level.
Try one step: For a real decision, write direction, value, and boundary separately, then place it on the spectrum with a reason. Do not substitute high/medium/low labels for evidence.
第5章。五个不可通约尺度与递归校准。个人、组织、城市、国家、人类五个尺度的意义不可通约。跨尺度协调不是加权求和，而是显式检查冲突、优先级、代价、触发条件与反馈。
公理三与 §4.3 禁止把异质价值换算成一个补偿性总分。一个尺度上的收益不能自动抵消另一个尺度上的伤害。智能体的 L5 因此输出冲突和优先级，而不是 weighted_score。
递归校准先保留各尺度的方向陈述，再检查两两冲突、优先级顺序、代价承担者和暂停触发器。若缺少输入，结果返回 needs_clarification，不用默认值编造。
跨尺度一致性相关 claim 仍处于研究状态。MI-C005 是 E1、Formalized；MI-C010 是 E1、Under Test。不能把“禁止加权求和”的工程规则误写成“跨尺度一致性已被证明能预测生存”。
五个尺度：个人、组织、城市、国家、人类。
不可通约：拒绝补偿性加总。
必要输出：冲突、优先级、代价、触发器。
缺失信息：显式待澄清。
动手一步：在一个组织决策中列出五个尺度的方向，至少写出一处真实冲突，并明确谁承担代价、什么信号触发暂停。

Chapter 5. Five incommensurable scales and recursive calibration. Meaning at the individual, organizational, city, national, and human scales is incommensurable. Cross-scale coordination is not weighted summation; it requires explicit conflicts, priorities, costs, triggers, and feedback.

Axiom 3 and §4.3 forbid converting heterogeneous values into one compensatory total. Gain at one scale does not automatically cancel harm at another. The agent's L5 therefore outputs conflicts and priorities, not a weighted_score.

Recursive calibration first preserves each scale's direction statement, then checks pairwise conflicts, priority order, who bears costs, and pause triggers. Missing input produces needs_clarification rather than invented defaults.

Claims about cross-scale consistency remain research-stage. MI-C005 is E1/Formalized; MI-C010 is E1/Under Test. The engineering rule against weighted summation must not be rewritten as proof that cross-scale consistency predicts survival.
Five scales: individual, organization, city, national, humanity.
Incommensurable: reject compensatory aggregation.
Required outputs: conflicts, priorities, costs, triggers.
Missing information: explicit clarification request.
Try one step: List directions at all five scales for one organizational decision, identify at least one real conflict, and state who bears the cost and what signal triggers a pause.
第6章。正典机制与工程栈的映射。正典运行机制包括 M1 感知、M2 判断、M3 行动三个模块，以及 F1 意义识别、F2 意义评估、F3 意义决策、F4 意义反馈四个流程。六层栈是把这些机制转译为工程结构的待检验假设。
L1 与 L2 主要落在 M1 的输入和呈现侧，并支持 F1；L3 与 L4 主要落在 M2 与 F2；L5 对应 M3 与 F3；L6 把 M1、M2、M3 重新串联并通过 F4 回写。这个映射用于解释工程意图，不用于授予证据等级。
界面带 L1–L2 处理“信息进不来”，加工带 L3–L4 处理“意义出不来”，元带 L5–L6 处理“方向守不住”。只有元带可以改写下层前提；L6 回写 L1 后形成螺旋，而不是一次性流水线。
架构文档特别区分 measured 与 planned 时间轴。MSI 渲染时 self.mark() 记录真实进入与退出时刻；缺少实测文件时，构建器才按配置推算并显示 planned。可体验不等于已验证。
三模块：M1 感知、M2 判断、M3 行动。
四流程：F1 识别、F2 评估、F3 决策、F4 反馈。
六层映射：工程解释，不是正典层定义。
时间轴：优先实测，缺失时可见降级。
动手一步：追踪一个输出从 L1 到 L6，标明它经过哪些模块和流程，以及哪一步有权改写前提。

Chapter 6. Mapping canon mechanisms to the engineering stack. Canon mechanisms include three modules—M1 perception, M2 judgment, M3 action—and four processes: F1 meaning identification, F2 meaning assessment, F3 meaning decision, F4 meaning feedback. The six-layer stack is a testable engineering translation, not the canon mechanism itself.

L1 and L2 mainly sit on M1's input and presentation side and support F1; L3 and L4 mainly map to M2 and F2; L5 maps to M3 and F3; L6 reconnects M1–M3 and writes back through F4. This mapping explains engineering intent; it does not grant evidence status.

The interface band L1–L2 addresses information not getting in; processing L3–L4 addresses meaning not coming out; meta L5–L6 addresses direction not holding. Only the meta band can rewrite lower premises. L6's return to L1 creates a spiral, not a one-pass pipeline.

The architecture distinguishes measured from planned timelines. During rendering, self.mark() records actual act entry and exit. Only when measured data is absent does the builder extrapolate from configuration and label it planned. Experienceable is not the same as validated.
Three modules: M1 perception, M2 judgment, M3 action.
Four processes: F1 identification, F2 assessment, F3 decision, F4 feedback.
Six-layer mapping: engineering explanation, not canon layer definitions.
Timeline: measured first, visibly degraded when absent.
Try one step: Trace one output from L1 to L6, naming the modules and processes it crosses and the step allowed to rewrite premises.
第7章。六层工程栈：L1–L6 与三带。六层栈是本项目提出的整合结构，证据等级 E0，未经独立检验。它由界面带、加工带、元带组成，每一层都有输入、输出、正典概念关联和待检验的工程边界。
L1 减负把信息整理成结构；L2 可体验把结构变成可操作界面；L3 意义生成组织方向、价值、边界；L4 价值评估标注证据；L5 方向选择处理五尺度冲突；L6 反思与审视递归检查前提、触发复核并可逆归零。
各层的工程操作化状态并不相同：L1/L2 为框架 E1、机制待核验；L3 为 E0–E1；L4 工具 E2、模型 E1；L5 为 E1；L6 为 E2。这些标签只描述当前记录，不能把六层栈整体升级。
若更简洁且解释力更强的切分出现，应替换六层栈，而不是为它辩护。工程失败条件只处置对应操作化，不自动推翻正典 H 假设或外部机制。
界面带：L1 减负、L2 可体验。
加工带：L3 意义生成、L4 价值评估。
元带：L5 方向选择、L6 反思递归。
栈整体：E0；层标签不能相加。
动手一步：把当前工作流的每一步标到 L1–L6；没有对应层的一步明确标为外部流程，不要硬塞进六层。

Chapter 7. The six-layer engineering stack: L1–L6 and three bands. The six-layer stack is an integrative structure proposed by this project at E0 and has not been independently tested. It comprises interface, processing, and meta bands; each layer has inputs, outputs, canon links, and testable engineering boundaries.

L1 structures information; L2 turns structure into an operable interface; L3 organizes direction, value, and boundary; L4 labels evidence; L5 handles five-scale conflicts; L6 reviews premises, triggers revision, and supports reversible zeroing.

Layer statuses differ: L1/L2 are framework E1 with mechanisms pending; L3 is E0–E1; L4 tools are E2 and model E1; L5 is E1; L6 is E2. These labels describe current records and do not upgrade the stack as a whole.

If a simpler partition with greater explanatory power appears, replace the stack rather than defend it. An engineering failure condition disposes of its operationalization, not automatically of canon H hypotheses or external mechanisms.
Interface band: L1 load reduction, L2 experiential rendering.
Processing band: L3 meaning generation, L4 value assessment.
Meta band: L5 direction selection, L6 recursive review.
Stack as a whole: E0; layer labels cannot be added together.
Try one step: Map each step of a current workflow to L1–L6. Mark steps with no match as external processes rather than forcing them into the stack.
第8章。六个智能体技能与注册契约。meaning-agent 的 engine.py 编排六个确定性技能，skills/registry.py 是唯一注册入口。每个技能信封包含名称、描述、层、输入、输出、状态、待澄清信息和数据。
六个注册名依次是 reduce-cognitive-load、model-experiential-interface、map-direction-value-boundary、grade-evidence-falsification、calibrate-five-scales、recursive-review-zeroing。名称与层号必须在注册表、技能文档、测试和 MCP 目录中保持一致。
L1 保留未验证标记；L2 只生成本地显示建议；L3 不替人选择；L4 不自动认定实证状态；L5 禁止加权求和；L6 最多三轮递归审视，不删除数据或执行操作。
技能输出是结构化草稿，不是事实核查、心理测量、法律意见或安全认证。缺少材料时返回 needs_clarification；可选 LLM 只能提供未核验的语言建议，不能改变确定性技能、证据等级、尺度聚合或批准。
唯一注册入口：skills/registry.py。
唯一编排入口：engine.py。
六份 SKILL.md：可复用的输入输出与边界契约。
输出必须可追溯到层、来源和限制。
动手一步：在测试中遍历六个注册名，确认每层只运行一次、输出信封完整、待澄清信息不被默认值覆盖。

Chapter 8. Six agent skills and the registry contract. meaning-agent's engine.py orchestrates six deterministic skills, with skills/registry.py as the sole registry. Each skill envelope includes name, description, layer, input, output, status, clarification needs, and data.

The registered names are reduce-cognitive-load, model-experiential-interface, map-direction-value-boundary, grade-evidence-falsification, calibrate-five-scales, and recursive-review-zeroing. Names and layer IDs must stay aligned across the registry, skill documents, tests, and MCP catalog.

L1 retains unverified markers; L2 only suggests local display behavior; L3 never chooses for a human; L4 never asserts empirical status; L5 forbids weighted summation; L6 allows at most three review passes and never deletes data or executes actions.

Skill outputs are structured drafts, not fact-checking, psychometrics, legal advice, or safety certification. Missing material produces needs_clarification. An optional LLM can only suggest unverified language; it cannot alter deterministic skills, evidence levels, scale aggregation, or approval.
Single registry entry: skills/registry.py.
Single orchestration entry: engine.py.
Six SKILL.md files: reusable input/output and boundary contracts.
Every output must trace to a layer, source, and limitation.
Try one step: In tests, iterate all six registered names and confirm each layer runs once, envelopes are complete, and clarification needs are not overwritten by defaults.
